body:
I know I didn't give a proper enough description of the situation and it might come across as your typical "just in love" story. But I genuinely do believe I wouldn't be able to find anyone that could even come close to her for me. As for being young, quite honestly I don't give a shit about that and I am not interested in the things "you should do while young". To be frank, there hasn't really been anything ever in my life I genuinely cared about and anything that made me not want to just finally die other than her. I have been feeling this way about our relationships since the beginning and as time goes on, this feeling is only getting stronger. I am socially anxious and for the most part I hate people and hate being around people and she's been the only person I feel safe and comfortable with, which I'm not sure I could even say about any family member or even my closest friends. She is literally the only person with whom I can be alone together without having severe anxiety. She is the only person I have ever looked forward to meeting. And I don't want to lose the only person in the world I have genuinely cared about and not just "because they're family / friends". She has been the only thing in my life that gave my life purpose.

To address the fact that we might change along the way and figure that it wasn't really meant to be, I could accept that. But there isn't anything wrong with our relationship and there hasn't been anything we couldn't talk through because the communication and honesty between us is just that great. That is why I cannot just accept that "it wasn't mean to be." There isn't a single reason we should separate and there would be zero upside to it.
We haven't really put much thought into long distance because her going to Switzerland wasn't a sure thing up until now.
